title: Stardate 20X6
description: Stardate 20X6 is an eight-level set by Zachary Stephens featuring underground and space-station themes centered on the color purple. It replaces many green palette colors with purple, offering abstract visuals and arena-style slaughtermap gameplay. The maps are very difficult without overwhelmingly high monster counts, with options included for casual playthroughs.
